mapper.select: SELECT account_number, status, nickname, email, popularity, in_date FROM accounts WHERE account_role = 1 ORDER BY account_number ASC
SELECT account_number, status, nickname, email, popularity, in_date FROM accounts WHERE nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') and account_role = 1 ORDER BY account_number ASC
SELECT account_number, status, nickname, email, popularity, in_date FROM accounts WHERE status = #{status} and account_role = #{roleUser} ORDER BY account_number DESC
SELECT account_number, status, nickname, email, popularity, in_date FROM accounts WHERE account_role = 1 ORDER BY popularity DESC
SELECT account_number, status, nickname, email, popularity, in_date FROM accounts WHERE account_role = 1 ORDER BY in_date DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(ATTENDEE_ID) FROM attendees at WHERE a.account_number = at.account_number) AS COUNT, c.club_number, a.attendee_role, c.club_name, f.festival_number, f.festival_name FROM attendees a JOIN clubs c ON a.club_number = c.club_number JOIN festivals f ON c.festival_number = f.festival_number JOIN attendees attd ON a.account_number = attd.account_number WHERE a.account_number = #{accountNumber};
